title: Change Reference to Value

solutions.title: Fare corrected by replacement, not mutation
solutions.tradeoff: Every fare correction now allocates a new Fare instead of editing the old one in place, and Fare.cents can no longer be watched for changes at a distance - a real cost if some future feature genuinely wanted to observe a fare mutate over time.

reviewFocus: Does bookRoundTrip still hand the same Fare instance to both legs - and does the solution's WALKTHROUGH correctly explain why that sharing is now harmless rather than removing it out of caution?
Does adjustTripFare, or anything it calls, ever mutate a Fare's cents after construction - including inside Fare itself - or does every correction go through reassigning the trip's own field?
Is Fare.cents actually declared readonly, or is immutability only a convention nothing enforces?
Read the comment above the aliasing guard test in tests/fare.spec.ts and the one explaining what is deliberately absent - do both still hold, or did a later step quietly make one of them false?
Compare against drill-09-05: does this solution's Fare earn value semantics by being small and safe to duplicate freely - the opposite of drill-09-05's Rider, which needs exactly one owner?
